release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.38 (Build 38) - iOS Launch Crash Fix:
- Fixed TestFlight/iOS crash on open (Firebase native double-init + WebRTC dSYM)
- AppDelegate now uses FlutterFire Dart initialization only
- Generate WebRTC.framework dSYM during archive for symbol upload and stable launch
- Added Bonjour service declarations for WebRTC local network
- Includes Arabic RTL text direction improvements from 1.0.37
